meta.description: RAS Copilot feature catalog. Single source of truth for every HEC-RAS model-data field, per RAS_COPILOT_PLAN.md Phase 0.
meta.installed_software_version: HEC-RAS 7.0 (confirmed installed locally, no bundled offline manuals found in install dir)
meta.scope_note: Catalog scope = actual model-data fields only: parameters that define the hydraulic/geometric model and would be read/written via the HEC-RASController COM interface (Phase 1). Pure UI/display chrome (schematic colors, zoom/pan, view-toggle checkboxes for what's drawn on screen, cut/copy/paste/undo mechanics, delete-record actions, navigation dropdowns that don't carry new data) is explicitly OUT of scope - it's not modeling capability and COM does not expose it. Scope was corrected to this definition on 2026-08-26 after an initial pass briefly included UI chrome; the UI-chrome entries from that pass were removed rather than kept in a mixed catalog.

meta.version_gap_warning: Manuals sourced (v6.4.1 / 6.0 / 6.6) are the newest full manuals findable; installed software is 7.0. Any field that appears in the live 7.0 UI but not in these manuals is NOT yet in this catalog and must be flagged/added after live-software confirmation (user has HEC-RAS 7.0 installed and can supply screenshots) rather than guessed.
meta.tier_methodology: tier (common/situational/rare) is the assistant's judgment call about typical-usage frequency across urban drainage / riverine flood / culvert design projects, per Phase 0 instructions. Unlike field existence and valid_range/units, tier is NOT independently sourced from the manual and should be treated as a starting proposal, not a verified fact.
meta.status: IN PROGRESS - module 1 of 9 (Geometry Editor) partially catalogued. Covers manual sections 6.1-6.3 (River System Schematic, Cross Section Data, Stream Junctions) only. Remaining Geometry Editor sections (6.4-6.22: Bridges/Culverts through Saving) and all other modules (Steady Flow, Unsteady Flow, 2D Flow Areas, Structures, Sediment, Water Quality, Plan/Run Manager, RAS Mapper) not yet catalogued.
